changes: Tick TRACK MUTES in PERSONALIZE and T1-T8 mute or unmute, including several at once. FUNC+T selects that track. An empty box is stock.
The checkbox is stored in this module, not in Mute Modes' battery word, so it returns to empty after power-off until a base settings store exists.

FUNC+REC1/2 on the MIDI page opens recorder buffers only while the box is ticked. USB install, self-test, Keep/Undo and removal are not tested. The 0.1.32 card's AED follow was reported for that card only.
